nodes.question: What are the implications of waste minimization using 3D printing and emissions reduction in the plastic reforming industry, as studied by Thomas and Mishra (2022)?
nodes.answer: The implications of waste minimization using 3D printing and emissions reduction in the plastic reforming industry can include reducing environmental pollution, conserving resources, and promoting sustainable manufacturing practices.
